joka: Joka station, the southern terminus of the Purple Line. Trains run from Joka through Thakurpukur, Sakherbazar and Behala Chowrasta to Majerhat, so a tutor who lives along the line can come by metro; check the current timetable before fixing a weekend class, or the tutor comes by road along Diamond Harbour Road.
Where does Joka sit on the map of Kolkata?

Right at the southern fringe, where the municipal corporation area stops. Thakurpukur is immediately north and Pailan south, with Maheshtala on the western side, and Bakhrahat Road leads out into South 24 Parganas. Tutors living in Thakurpukur and the rest of Behala are therefore usually the closest match for a Joka home.
Will a Joka housing complex ask about a visiting tutor?

Usually, yes. The newer complexes keep a register at the gate, so give the tutor's name, tower and flat number before the free demo. Older family houses on the lanes are a simple doorstep visit, and naming a landmark close to the metro station helps a first-time visitor find the right turning.
What should a Joka family expect to pay a home tutor?

That depends on the tutor, the class and the subject, because each tutor on NXTutors sets their own fee. You see the fee of every matched tutor before the free demo, so nothing is agreed until you have met the tutor and compared the two or three options side by side.
sarsuna: What is the Sarsuna Satellite Township?

A planned housing estate built by the West Bengal Housing Board, where the first allotments were made in 1985. It mixes vacant plots, ready-built houses and four-storey apartment blocks across two phases, so a tutor's visit in the same few streets can be to a house, a flat or a newer building.
How does a tutor reach Sarsuna when it has no station?

By the Purple Line to Sakherbazar or Behala Chowrasta in neighbouring Barisha, then an auto or bus for the last part. Buses also run into Sarsuna itself. Naming your para, for example Sonamukhi or Kashthadanga, or a landmark near Shakuntala Park, helps a new tutor plan the route before the demo.

Barisha lies to the east and Maheshtala to the west, and Sarsuna marks the south-western limit of the municipal corporation area. Its small paras run from Shakuntala Park to Raidighi, so tutors who live in Barisha, Behala or Thakurpukur are often the nearest match when a Sarsuna family asks for home tuition.
Can a Sarsuna family change tutor if the first match does not suit?

Yes, and switching later costs nothing. NXTutors suggests two or three tutors for each request, nearest first, and the first class with each of them is a free demo. You also see every tutor's fee before that demo, so the final choice is made on clear terms and at your own pace.
barisha: Which Purple Line stations are inside Barisha?

Sakherbazar and Behala Chowrasta, both on Diamond Harbour Road. Trains run between Joka and Majerhat, so a tutor who lives elsewhere on the line can reach a Barisha home by metro and finish the trip on foot or by auto from either station.
What is the difference between Paschim and Purba Barisha?

They are the western and eastern halves of one old locality. Between them they take in Behala Chowrasta, Janakalyan, Silpara and Sakherbazar, running up to Thakurpukur. Telling the tutor which half you live in, and the nearest station or landmark, saves time on the first visit to your home.
Is Barisha known for anything besides housing?

Yes, for its long heritage. A family Durga Puja here dates from 1610, and the Barisha Chandi Mela, a local fair, has been held every year since 1792. Families who want lessons to pause for Puja week can settle that calendar with the tutor at the free demo class.
How are home-tuition fees set for a Barisha student?

Each tutor decides a rate for the class and subject, and NXTutors displays it with the match before any lesson takes place. Since the first session with every suggested tutor is a free demo, a Barisha family can weigh fee, travel and teaching style together before committing to regular classes.
haridevpur: Which metro station is nearest to Haridevpur?

Mahanayak Uttam Kumar on the Blue Line, at Tollygunge. From there buses and autos run along the main road towards Thakurpukur and Joka. Tollygunge station on the Budge Budge suburban line is close by as well, so a tutor coming by metro or train reaches Haridevpur with one short change.
Is Haridevpur part of Behala or Tollygunge?

It sits between the two. Haridevpur is usually described as part of the Tollygunge area, yet its police station belongs to the South West division, and NXTutors places it in the Behala & New Alipore zone. That means tutors living on either side can reach it, which widens the choice for families.
What kind of home will a tutor visit in Haridevpur?

Mostly a flat in a low or mid-rise apartment building, or an independent house on a side street. Small buildings usually mean going straight up to the door, while a few newer blocks note visitors at the entrance, so share the tutor's name and flat number before the first lesson.
How does NXTutors choose tutors for a Haridevpur request?

Tutors who live in or near Haridevpur come first, then the rest of the Behala & New Alipore zone, then the wider city, then online tutors. You receive two or three names, each with the tutor's own fee shown up front, and the first class with every one of them is a free demo.
park-circus: Which station should a tutor use for Park Circus?

Park Circus station on the Sealdah South suburban lines, which lies between Sealdah and Ballygunge Junction. Rabindra Sadan on the Blue Line is the nearest metro to the west, and the Park Circus Connector leads east to the EM Bypass for tutors coming from Kasba, Garia or Salt Lake by the Orange Line.

Entally and Sealdah lie to the north, Park Street and Chowringhee to the west, Tangra to the north-east, Topsia to the east and Ballygunge to the south. NXTutors places Park Circus in the Ballygunge, Gariahat & Alipore zone, so tutors from those neighbouring areas are matched early.
Do Park Circus buildings check a tutor at the entrance?

Many apartment buildings have a security desk that will ask for the tutor's name and flat number, so share them before the demo. Older houses in the side lanes are usually a doorstep visit. Mentioning Park Circus Ground or the nearest station as a landmark helps a tutor who has not visited before.
Are the tutors suggested for Park Circus checked?

Tutors who join NXTutors go through an ID check: they confirm a phone number or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID that the team reviews, and the badge on the tutor card appears once that review is done. It is not a police check, so meet the tutor at the free demo class and decide for yourself.
southern-avenue: Where exactly does Southern Avenue run?

From Gariahat Road in the east to the Kalighat side in the west, linking Golpark with Kalighat beside Rabindra Sarobar, the large artificial lake. Lake Road and Keyatala Road are among the side streets. Giving the nearest crossing or side road helps a tutor find a home along this long avenue.
Which metro stop is closest to Southern Avenue?

Kalighat on the Blue Line. Tutors from Tollygunge, Garia or north Kolkata can ride the Blue Line there and walk or take an auto to the avenue. Ballygunge Junction on the Sealdah South suburban lines, beyond Gariahat to the east, suits tutors who travel by local train instead.
Is a Southern Avenue visit a doorstep call or a building desk?

Both are common. The private bungalows along the avenue are a doorstep visit, while the tall apartment buildings have a desk or intercom that will ask for the tutor's name. Share the flat number and building name with the tutor before the first lesson to save time at the entrance.
What happens after a Southern Avenue family sends a request?

NXTutors suggests two or three matched tutors, nearest first, and the first class with each is a free demo. Every tutor's fee is shown before that demo. If the tutor you choose stops working out later, switching to another one is free, so you are never locked in.
bijoygarh: As one of the colonies set up by families arriving from East Pakistan after 1947. By 1949 the Jadavpur area held about forty such colonies, and Bijoygarh was among them. The colony was laid out in house plots, which is why many streets still have family houses alongside newer apartment buildings.
Which stations are nearest to Bijoygarh?

Jadavpur and Baghajatin stations on the Sealdah South suburban lines are the nearest railway stops, and Mahanayak Uttam Kumar on the Blue Line is the metro station usually given for the area. Tutors living in Jadavpur, Tollygunge or Garia can reach a Bijoygarh home with a single change.

Jadavpur, Baghajatin, Bikramgarh, Regent Estate and Ranikuthi share its boundaries. NXTutors places Bijoygarh in the Tollygunge, Jadavpur & Garia zone, so tutors from those neighbours are suggested early, and a tutor who already teaches nearby can often fit your lesson into the same afternoon round.
Will a Bijoygarh family know the tutor's fee before starting?

Yes. Every matched tutor's fee, which the tutor sets personally, is visible before the free demo, so a Bijoygarh family knows the cost of regular lessons in advance. If the first choice stops suiting your child later, moving to a different tutor costs nothing, and the new tutor's fee is shown first too.
tiljala: Which metro and railway stations serve Tiljala?

VIP Bazar and Ritwik Ghatak on the Orange Line, open since August 2025, serve the bypass side. Ballygunge Junction and Park Circus on the Sealdah South suburban lines are the nearest railway stations. Tutors from Kasba, Mukundapur or Garia can come straight up the Orange Line and finish by auto.
Where is Tiljala in relation to its neighbours?

The EM Bypass runs along its eastern side, Ballygunge lies to the west, Kasba to the south and Topsia to the north. Picnic Garden Road is one of its main streets. NXTutors groups Tiljala in the Kasba & EM Bypass South zone, so tutors from those areas come up first.
Can a Tiljala family ask for a tutor who explains in Hindi or Bengali?

Yes. Tiljala is home to Bengali, Marwari, Punjabi, Anglo-Indian and Nepali families, and many ask for a tutor who can explain in a home language as well as English. Mention it in the request, and judge the tutor's style at the free demo before you decide.
When does a Tiljala family learn what a tutor charges?

Before any paid lesson. Each tutor sets a personal fee, and NXTutors puts it on the match you receive, ahead of the free demo. Compare the two or three suggestions on fee, travel and how clearly they teach, then continue with whichever one suits your child.
topsia: Is there a metro station in Topsia?

Yes. Ritwik Ghatak station on the Orange Line, earlier called Topsia, opened in August 2025. It links the area with Kasba, Mukundapur and Garia along the EM Bypass. Park Circus on the Sealdah South suburban lines is the nearest railway station for tutors who travel by local train.
How does a tutor get into a Topsia residential tower?

By checking in at the lobby desk, which usually calls the flat for approval. Give security the tutor's name and the time of the class beforehand so the first visit goes smoothly. On the older streets away from the bypass, a tutor goes straight to the door.

It was one of the villages bought by the East India Company in 1758 and later drew workers from Bihar and Uttar Pradesh to the tanneries and factories nearby. In recent years tall residential towers have risen near the bypass, while the older streets keep their low buildings.
How many tutors will a Topsia family be offered?

Two or three. NXTutors lists tutors living in or near Topsia first, then the Kasba & EM Bypass South zone, then the wider city and online tutors. The first class with each is a free demo, every fee is shown beforehand, and switching later is free.
anandapur: Which metro station is nearest to Anandapur?

Hemanta Mukhopadhyay on the Orange Line, at the Ruby crossing on the EM Bypass, open since March 2024. From the station an auto runs along Anandapur Main Road. Ballygunge Junction on the Sealdah South suburban lines is the nearest railway station, and buses link Anandapur with Garia and Ballygunge.
Where does Anandapur end and the next area begin?

Anandapur marks the south-eastern limit of the municipal corporation area. Anandapur Main Road joins the EM Bypass on one side, and Anandapur High Road leads on to Kalikapur, Adarsh Nagar and Bantala. It falls in ward 108, and tutors from Kasba, Mukundapur and Garia are usually the nearest match for a home here.
How should an Anandapur family arrange entry for a tutor?

Most homes are in large gated complexes, so pre-register the tutor with the security office and share the tower and flat number before the free demo. Some complexes issue a regular pass once lessons are fixed, which saves time at the gate on every later visit.
Can an Anandapur student mix home and online tuition?

Yes. A family can keep a home tutor for school subjects and add an online tutor for a specialist area, such as an IB or JEE topic. NXTutors shows two or three matches for each kind of request, every fee before the free demo, and switching to another tutor later is free.
haltu: Which stations can a tutor use to reach Haltu?

Ballygunge Junction, Dhakuria and Jadavpur on the Sealdah South suburban lines, and Kavi Sukanta on the Orange Line at Kalikapur, open since March 2024. A tutor from Jadavpur or Dhakuria can come by train, and one from Mukundapur or Garia by metro, then take an auto along Garfa Main Road or Kalikapur Road.

Kasba, Jadavpur, Dhakuria, Kalikapur and Selimpur. Garfa Main Road and Kalikapur Road cross at its centre. NXTutors places Haltu in the Kasba & EM Bypass South zone, so tutors from those neighbours are suggested early, and because both the railway and the bypass are close, the pool is wide.
What kind of buildings will a tutor visit in Haltu?

Mostly apartment buildings: older ones on the inner roads and newer complexes towards the EM Bypass. In a smaller building the tutor rings the bell and goes up; a newer complex may ask for a name at the gate, so share it in advance along with a nearby landmark.
Who decides the fee for a Haltu home tutor?

The tutor does. Rates differ by class, subject and experience, and NXTutors shows each matched tutor's figure before the free demo rather than after it. A Haltu family can therefore try the demo, see the fee in writing, and only then decide whether to book regular weekly lessons.
survey-park: Which Orange Line stations serve Survey Park?

Jyotirindra Nandi, at Mukundapur, and Satyajit Ray, at Panchasayar, both on the EM Bypass and open since March 2024. The line runs north to Kalikapur, the Ruby crossing and Beleghata and south to New Garia, so tutors on either side can come by metro and take an auto to your street.
Is Survey Park the same as Santoshpur?

It is a locality within the wider Santoshpur area, in municipal ward 109, next to Chak Garia and Ajoy Nagar. It has its own police station, created in 2011. NXTutors treats it as its own page so that tutors living right in Survey Park are listed first.
Will a tutor be stopped at the gate in Survey Park?

In the larger complexes, yes: they keep a register at the gate, so share the tutor's name and flat number first. Most buildings here are small, though, and the tutor simply goes up to the door, so tell the tutor which kind of building you live in.
How quickly can a Survey Park family start lessons?

As soon as you pick a tutor after the free demo. NXTutors suggests two or three matches, nearest first, each with a fee shown up front. The demo with each is free, and if the tutor you choose stops suiting your child later, switching costs nothing.
ajoy-nagar: Which metro stations are nearest to Ajoy Nagar?

Jyotirindra Nandi, at Mukundapur, and Satyajit Ray, at Panchasayar, both on the Orange Line along the EM Bypass and open since March 2024. Kavi Subhash at New Garia, the line's southern end, is close too. From any of them an auto or a bus covers the final stretch to your street.

Santoshpur, Mukundapur and Garia, with the EM Bypass close by. It shares municipal ward 109 and its postcode with Survey Park. NXTutors places Ajoy Nagar in the Kasba & EM Bypass South zone, so tutors living in those neighbouring areas are the first suggested for a home here.
Can a tutor reach Ajoy Nagar by local train?

Yes. Garia station on the Sealdah South main line is the usual stop, and autos and buses run from there. That suits tutors who live along the suburban line, while those on the bypass side tend to use the Orange Line stations at Mukundapur and Panchasayar.
Do Ajoy Nagar families pay for the trial class?

No. The first class with each tutor NXTutors suggests is a free demo, and the fee for regular lessons, set by the tutor, is shown before it. You can try two or three demos in the same week and pick the tutor whose explanations your child follows most easily.
birati: Is there a metro station in Birati?

Not yet. A Yellow Line station under Jessore Road at Birati More is under construction. For now, Birati station on the Sealdah–Bangaon line is the local rail link, and Dum Dum Cantonment, further down the same line, connects with the Yellow Line, which has run to the airport since August 2025.

In the North Dum Dum municipality of North 24 Parganas, next to the airport. Jessore Road runs along its east, the Kalyani Expressway along its west and the Belghoria Expressway to its south. NXTutors places it in the Lake Town, Dum Dum & Baguiati zone.
How should a Birati family time lessons with a tutor who comes by train?

Agree a start time that fits the Sealdah–Bangaon line timetable, since many tutors reach Birati by local train. A fixed weekday slot after school is easiest to keep. Small apartment buildings usually mean a doorstep visit, while larger complexes may want a name at the gate.
What does a Birati family get from NXTutors?

Two or three matched tutors, with those living in Birati and Dum Dum first, each with a fee shown before the first class. The first class with each tutor is a free demo, and if the tutor you choose stops suiting your child later, switching to another one is free.
kaikhali: Which metro stations are nearest to Kaikhali?

Jai Hind (Biman Bandar) at the airport and Jessore Road, both on the Yellow Line and open since August 2025. A large number of bus routes also run along VIP Road. The Orange Line towards the airport is under construction, so for now most tutors arrive by bus or the Yellow Line.
Which neighbourhoods are close to Kaikhali?

Lake Town, Dum Dum Park, Kestopur, Baguiati, Nagerbazar, Teghoria, Chinar Park, New Town and Salt Lake. Kaikhali sits near the northern end of VIP Road, by the airport, in Bidhannagar Municipal Corporation wards 5 to 7, and NXTutors places it in the Lake Town, Dum Dum & Baguiati zone.
Do Kaikhali housing enclaves register visiting tutors?

Most gated enclaves do, so share the tutor's name, block and flat number before the free demo. Smaller apartment buildings are usually a doorstep visit. Tutors living in Baguiati, Kestopur or Teghoria are close by and can often fit a Kaikhali lesson into the same round.
Can a Kaikhali family compare tutor fees?

Yes. NXTutors suggests two or three tutors for each request, and each shows a self-set fee before the free demo. Laying those fees beside the travel from Baguiati, Kestopur or Teghoria and the demo itself gives you a fair basis for choosing, and a later switch is free.
hatibagan: Which metro stations are closest to Hatibagan?

Shobhabazar Sutanuti and Shyambazar, both on the Blue Line, which runs on south through Girish Park to Esplanade. From either station a tutor can walk or take a rickshaw into the lanes. Kolkata station is the nearest railway terminal, which suits tutors coming in on the northern suburban lines.
Where does the name Hatibagan come from?

It joins the Bengali words for elephant and garden. One story links it to elephants kept here during the attack on Calcutta in 1756. Today the area is known for Hatibagan Market, one of the oldest traditional markets in the city, and for its many old theatres and cinema halls.
What kind of home will a tutor visit in Hatibagan?

Mostly an older family house or a flat in an apartment building on the lanes off the main roads. In a house the tutor is let in at the door; apartment buildings may ask for a name at the entrance. Share a landmark such as the market to make the first visit easy.
Which tutors will NXTutors suggest for Hatibagan?

Tutors who live in or near Hatibagan first, then the rest of the North Kolkata zone, then the wider city, then online tutors. You get two or three names, each with the fee shown up front, and the first class with each is a free demo.
ultadanga: Bidhannagar Road station on the Sealdah–Ranaghat line and the Circular Railway, plus Phoolbagan and Bengal Chemical on the Green Line and Shyambazar and Shobhabazar Sutanuti on the Blue Line. That mix lets tutors reach Ultadanga by local train or metro from most parts of the city.
Where does the name Ultadanga come from?

It is said to come from Ulta Dingi, a place where small boats were made or repaired. Ultadanga was one of the villages the East India Company obtained in 1758 and became a fringe ward of the city in 1889. VIP Road, which leads to the airport, begins here.
Do Ultadanga housing blocks ask tutors to sign in?

Government housing blocks and apartment complexes usually do, so share the tutor's name and flat number before the free demo. Older houses on the side streets are a doorstep visit. Naming Hudco More or Bidhannagar Road station as a landmark helps a tutor find your building.
Can an Ultadanga student get an online tutor as well?

Yes. NXTutors lists home tutors nearest Ultadanga first, then the North Kolkata zone, then the wider city, and adds online tutors for specialist subjects such as IB or JEE preparation. Each match shows a fee before the first class, the demo is free, and switching later costs nothing.
kankurgachi: Phoolbagan, Bengal Chemical and Salt Lake Stadium, all on the Green Line. Since August 2025 the line has run straight through from Howrah Maidan to Salt Lake Sector V, so tutors from Howrah, Sealdah and Salt Lake can come by metro. CIT Road also carries many bus routes.
How did the Kankurgachi township begin?

It began in the 1960s, at the same time as Salt Lake. Before that, Kankurgachi was one of the villages acquired by the East India Company in 1758, named after kankur, a kind of melon that grew well here. Housing is now largely high-rise apartment buildings.
How does a tutor enter a Kankurgachi apartment building?

Most buildings have a guard or an intercom, so give the tutor's name and flat number before the free demo. Some ask visitors to sign a register. Naming the junction of Maniktala Main Road and CIT Road as a landmark helps a tutor who has not visited before.
Is the Kankurgachi tutor's fee fixed by NXTutors?

No. Tutors set their own fee, and NXTutors simply shows it to you on every match before the free demo. That lets a Kankurgachi family compare fees, experience and travel from Salt Lake or Sealdah side by side, and change tutor later at no extra cost.
phoolbagan: Is there a metro station in Phoolbagan?

Yes. Phoolbagan station on the Green Line is right in the locality, and since August 2025 the line has run straight through from Howrah to Salt Lake Sector V. Sealdah station, Sir Gurudas Banerjee Halt and Bidhannagar Road station are the nearby railway stops for tutors who prefer local trains.
Where is Phoolbagan and what is it known for?

It sits at the junction of CIT Road and Narkeldanga Main Road, with the EM Bypass on its eastern edge, bordering Beliaghata and Kankurgachi. Both roads were cut through older built-up areas in the 1930s. Subhas Sarovar, a large lake and well-known open space, lies within the locality and makes an easy landmark.
Will a tutor go to the door or stop at a desk in Phoolbagan?

It depends on the home. Independent houses are a doorstep visit, while apartment buildings may ask for a name at the entrance. Share the tutor's name, the building and a landmark such as Subhas Sarovar or the metro station before the first lesson, so the visit starts on time.
Does a Phoolbagan family pay anything for the demo?

No. The first class with each matched tutor is a free demo, and NXTutors suggests two or three tutors for every request, with those living nearest Phoolbagan first. Every tutor's own fee is shown before that demo, and switching to another tutor later, if needed, is free.
beliaghata: Beleghata on the Orange Line, on the EM Bypass end of Beliaghata Main Road, opened in August 2025, and Phoolbagan on the Green Line is nearby. Sealdah is the nearest railway station. Tutors from Kasba, Garia, Salt Lake or Howrah can therefore reach Beliaghata by metro.
How old is Beliaghata as a city neighbourhood?

It was one of the villages on which the East India Company obtained rights in 1717 and was taken into the city's municipal area in 1889, when several fringe villages joined. Beleghata Sarkar Bari, a family house built in 1892, is a local heritage landmark that tutors can use to find the way.
What should a tutor expect on a Beliaghata visit?

Many homes are low houses along narrow lanes, so a tutor often walks the last stretch from the main road and goes straight to the door. Apartment buildings on the wider roads may ask for a name. Share the lane name and a landmark before the free demo.
How does a Beliaghata family find out a tutor's rate?

It is on the match itself. Every tutor NXTutors suggests carries the fee they set, visible before the free demo, so nothing is left unclear after the first lesson. Two or three options arrive for each request, with tutors nearest Beliaghata listed ahead of those further away.
baranagar: Baranagar metro station on the Blue Line, opened on 22 February 2021, and Baranagar Road station on the Sealdah–Dankuni suburban line, which stand side by side. Dakshineswar, the Blue Line's northern end, is close too, so tutors from north Kolkata and Dum Dum can come by metro or local train.

It is a separate town just north of the city, with its own municipality, set up in 1869 and one of the oldest in India. It lies on the east bank of the Hooghly, bounded by Dakshineswar and South Dum Dum. NXTutors groups it with the North Kolkata zone.
What kind of home will a tutor visit in Baranagar?

Mostly a flat in an older apartment building or a standalone house. Houses are a doorstep visit, while apartment buildings may want the tutor's name at the gate. Naming Dunlop crossing, Barrackpore Trunk Road or the metro station as a landmark helps on the first visit.
Are tutors suggested for Baranagar ID-checked?

Tutors who join NXTutors confirm a phone number or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID, which the team reviews. It is not a police or background check, so use the free demo to judge the tutor in person.
liluah: How does a tutor reach Liluah?

Usually by local train. Liluah station has platforms on both the Howrah–Bardhaman main line and the chord line, so tutors from across Howrah and the Hooghly side can arrive easily. The Grand Trunk Road crosses the eastern part of Liluah and carries the buses, and autos and rickshaws cover the last stretch.
Why is Liluah linked with the railway?

The Carriage and Wagon Workshop moved here from near Howrah station around 1900 and became the largest combined carriage and wagon workshop of Indian Railways. A railway colony for its staff had grown up by 1913. The eastern side later became mainly commercial and residential, while the western side kept some industry alongside newer housing.
Can a Liluah family ask for a tutor who teaches in Hindi and English?

Yes. Hindi is widely spoken in Liluah alongside Bengali, and many families ask for a tutor comfortable in both. Note it in your request, and use the free demo to check that the tutor's explanations, in either language, work for your child before you decide on regular lessons.
What does a Liluah family get after sending a request?

Two or three matched tutors, those in or near Liluah first, then the rest of the Howrah zone, the wider city and online tutors. Each one shows a fee before the first class, the demo with each is free, and if a tutor stops suiting your child, switching later costs nothing.
bally: Bally, Bally Ghat and Bally Halt, all on the suburban network. Dakshineswar, the northern end of the Blue Line, is just across the river by Vivekananda Setu or Nivedita Setu, so tutors from north Kolkata and Baranagar can reach Bally as easily as those coming by local train from Howrah.

It is the northernmost part of Howrah, on the west bank of the Hooghly. Bally Canal separates it from Uttarpara, and Belur and Liluah lie to its south. The Grand Trunk Road and the Belghoria Expressway pass through, and NXTutors places Bally in the Howrah zone.
Is a Bally tuition visit to a house or a flat?

Both are common. Bally has a mix of family houses and apartment buildings; a house is a doorstep visit, while newer buildings may ask for a name at the gate. Share the tutor's name and the nearest station, ghat or other landmark before the free demo, so the first visit starts on time.
Can a Bally family see tutor fees before the first lesson?

Yes. Tutors set their own fees and NXTutors shows each one with the match, ahead of the free demo. Because tutors from both sides of the river can reach Bally, you may see a range of fees, so compare them alongside the demo itself before choosing.
kadamtala: Which stations are nearest to Kadamtala?

Dasnagar and Tikiapara on the South Eastern suburban line, and Howrah station close by. Howrah Maidan, the Green Line's western terminus on the Grand Trunk Road, opened in March 2024, and since August 2025 the line has run straight through to Sealdah and Salt Lake Sector V.

With the railway. After Howrah terminus opened in 1854, flour mills followed in 1855 and then jute mills; after the Second World War the area turned to small iron-casting works. Today it is mainly residential, though many small workshops remain on the side streets near New HIT Road.
Can a tutor from Kolkata reach Kadamtala easily?

Yes, more easily than before. The Green Line now runs under the Hooghly to Howrah Maidan, so a tutor from Sealdah or Salt Lake can come by metro and take a short auto ride. Homes are mostly houses and low apartment buildings, so the tutor usually goes straight to the door.
How does NXTutors choose tutors for a Kadamtala family?

It lists tutors in or near Kadamtala first, then the rest of the Howrah zone, then Kolkata across the river, then online tutors. You see two or three names, each with the tutor's fee before the free demo, and you can switch to another tutor later at no cost.
